events.name: Bash
events.head: Size up the probe and find the hold guard
events.input: $ wc -l app/scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs cloud/src/jobs-delivery.ts cloud/src/settings.ts && grep -n "heldByPreview" -r cloud/src | head -20 && git log --oneline -5 -- app/scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs && git status --short app/scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs cloud/src | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read delivery job header, its routes and existing delivery probes
events.input: $ sed -n 1,27p cloud/src/jobs-delivery.ts | cut -c1-260; grep -n "jobs-delivery\|runDelivery\|deliver" cloud/src/index.ts | head -20; ls app/scripts | grep -i "deliver\|probe-day\|output" | head; grep -n "PREVIEW_HOLD" cloud/src/settings.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the delivery run, its admin routes and how the existing delivery probe drives them
events.input: $ sed -n 222,275p cloud/src/jobs-delivery.ts | cut -c1-330; echo ----; sed -n 818,846p cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-300; echo ----; grep -n "deliveryStatus" -A22 cloud/src/jobs-delivery.ts | grep -v "^--$" | cut -c1-260 | head -40; echo ---; grep -n "delivery/\|delivery\"" app/scripts/probe-day-delivery.mjs | cut -c1-260 | head -30; sed -n 1,25p app/scripts/probe-day-delivery.mjs | cut -c1-240

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show the rest of the saved output
events.input: $ F=/Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/0e8371a8-5bdf-4980-8dd9-44e0b9950235/tool-results/b0s1c92ea.txt; sed -n 25,33p $F | cut -c1-300; echo; awk '/^----$/{n++} n>=1' $F | cut -c1-280 | sed -n 1,95p

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the delivery probe setup and find how the local centre and simulator start
events.input: $ sed -n 54,112p app/scripts/probe-day-delivery.mjs | cut -c1-420; echo ----; grep -rn "8961\|vendor-sim\|SIM_URL" app/scripts/run-chain.sh cloud/package.json cloud/wrangler.toml cloud/.dev.vars.example 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-240 | head -20; ls app/scripts | grep -i "sim\|local-centre\|start" | head; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | grep -E ":(8961|8883|8893|8790) " | head

events.text: Adding the day output hold checks to the probe now; next I need to find how the local centre and vendor simulator are started so I can run it.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find the launcher for the local centre and simulator, and which ports are in use
events.input: $ grep -rln "8883\|8961" --include=*.md --include=*.sh --include=*.json --include=*.mjs . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -12; ls cloud | head -30; grep -n "SIM_URL\|ADMIN_KEY" cloud/wrangler.toml cloud/wrangler.jsonc 2>/dev/null | head; ls app/scripts | grep -i "sim" ; ls cloud/.dev.vars >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo devvars-exists; grep -rn "probe-preview-close" workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-291.json 2>/dev/null | grep -o "wrangler dev[^\"]\{0,200\}\|vendor-sim[^\"]\{0,160\}" | head -6; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1,$9}' | sort -u | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: List helper scripts, dev variable names (not values) and listening ports
events.input: $ ls cloud/scripts app/scripts | grep -iv "^probe-\|^\.t" | head -50; grep -n '"scripts"' -A12 cloud/package.json | head -16; grep -n "SIM_URL" -r cloud/src/util.ts cloud/wrangler.jsonc | head -5; grep -c . cloud/.dev.vars; cut -d= -f1 cloud/.dev.vars; grep -rl "8961" .claude/launch.json app/scripts/*.sh cloud/scripts 2>/dev/null | head; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1,$9}' | sort -u | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate the vendor simulator and the commands the earlier run used
events.input: $ grep -rIl "__state" --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.next --exclude-dir=out . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "probe-" | head -8; grep -o "wrangler dev[^\"\\\\]\{0,220\}" workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-291.json 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -5; grep -o "[a-zA-Z/._-]*sim[a-zA-Z/._-]*\.\(mjs\|py\|js\)[^\"\\\\]\{0,120\}" workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-291.json 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find the simulator source and the recorded start commands
events.input: $ grep -rIl "revops-vendor-sim" --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.next --exclude-dir=out --exclude-dir=live --exclude-dir=activity . 2>/dev/null | head -8; grep -rhoE "(wrangler dev|node [^ ]*sim[^ ]*)[^\"\\\\]{0,200}" workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-291.json workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-033.json 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -8; grep -n "vendor-sim\|SIM_URL\|--var" /Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory/*.md 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-300 | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the dev launcher and the simulator's environment options
events.input: $ cat cloud/scripts/run-dev.sh | cut -c1-300 | head -30; grep -n "environ" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | cut -c1-200 | head -12

events.head: Run the preview close probe on the local centre
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app && ADMIN_KEY="$(grep '^ADMIN_KEY=' ../cloud/.dev.vars | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"')" CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8961 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8883 node scripts/probe-preview-close.mjs 2>&1 | cut -c1-330 | tail -45
